name: @vrmxg/bundle
description: VRMXG game builds (M5 W0): a project exported as a playable web folder (a prebuilt runtime copied in by hash, the project's files beside it, and a manifest listing every file with its SHA-256 and its licence), the same bytes from Node and from the editor; a loader that opens a build and refuses what the manifest doesn't list; the Vite plugin that makes a runtime.
